about.title: About
about.intro: Frontend Developer with 10 years of experience specializing in modern, scalable web interfaces. Skilled in React, Angular, and Vue, with a focus on designing robust, high-performance architectures. I combine technical expertise with attention to detail and industry best practices to deliver exceptional results. Passionate about solving complex challenges and collaborating with teams to create innovative digital products. Always striving to exceed expectations in every project.

highlights: I work on the development, evolution, and maintenance of critical banking applications, with a strong focus on front-end software engineering, security, performance, scalability, and solution quality.
Development & Architecture: Building complex and scalable interfaces using Angular, TypeScript, and RxJS, applying componentization, low coupling, and sustainable architectural principles.
Software Engineering & Quality: Applying Clean Code, SOLID principles, Design Patterns, and software engineering best practices to deliver code that is readable, testable, maintainable, and scalable.
Integration & Security: Developing and integrating RESTful APIs and microservices, addressing security, authentication, reliability, and other requirements inherent to the financial sector.
Performance & Optimization: Continuously analyzing and optimizing application performance, reducing processing overhead and improving load times, responsiveness, and overall user experience.

Troubleshooting & High Availability: Investigating, diagnosing, and resolving complex technical issues and critical incidents, identifying root causes and contributing to the stability and availability of highly critical systems.

Testing & Continuous Delivery: Developing and maintaining automated tests, including unit and integration tests, contributing to delivery reliability and the continuous improvement of CI/CD processes.

items.title: Lumi
items.description: Mobile app for Christian devotional consistency: it helps users keep a daily habit of prayer and Bible reading with streaks, XP, achievements, reminders and the Lumi mascot, which reacts to their progress. Bible integrated through YouVersion, Supabase backend and a Portuguese/English interface.

items.title: CrunchySync
items.description: Android app to manage your Crunchyroll watch history straight from your phone, with no server of its own: history grouped by series, filters, bulk removal with a final check, and in-app updates. Sign-in happens on the official page, so the app never sees your password.

items.title: Addiction Catalog
